# Namos Sessions

> Conference program management from call for proposals through review, speaker coordination, scheduling, communications, and publication.

## Open Live Demo

https://app.namos-sessions.xyz/demo

One GET opens a fresh, isolated, seeded Namos Sessions workspace directly in Schedule Studio. No signup, password, access key, Turnstile, or manual role selection is required. Demo workspaces expire automatically.

## Core Features

- Conditional CFP forms and public event pages
- Abstract review, assignments, scoring, and decisions
- Speaker profiles, tasks, resources, documents, and portal forms
- Agenda scheduling with room, speaker, and availability conflict detection
- Communications, calendar-invite previews, and publication workflows
- Resettable seeded organizer, reviewer, and speaker data

## Public Routes

- Homepage: https://app.namos-sessions.xyz/
- Live demo: https://app.namos-sessions.xyz/demo
- Demo role chooser: https://app.namos-sessions.xyz/demo/start
- AI guide: https://app.namos-sessions.xyz/llms.txt

## Technology

React, TypeScript, Vite, Convex, Clerk, and Cloudflare Workers.
